Matthew Arnold (1822–88).  The Poems of Matthew Arnold, 1840–1867.  1909.

New Poems, 1867

A Caution to Poets

[First published 1867.]
W
HAT
 poets feel not, when they make,
A pleasure in creating,
The world, in 
its
 turn, will not take
Pleasure in contemplating.
